name: Kung Fu Betty
reviewNotes:
Added automatically from Salt Shack at Cedar Beach (Babylon) - beach music calendar. Check the name and add a website or social page.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Website and Facebook come from Salt Shack's artist page. kungfubetty.com blocks all crawlers in robots.txt (Disallow: /), so its pages, booking details and images were not read; check it by hand for a logo, photos and a booking/contact page. Salt Shack's artist page has a band photo, but it is on the venue's site, not the band's, so it was not used. YouTube @kungfubetty is a personal playlist channel, not the band. Not related to the Connecticut funk band Kung Fu. Did not record the LLC's registered address (private).
description: A cover band from Amityville on Long Island's South Shore that plays a wide mix of rock and pop from many decades, from Elvis and Lynyrd Skynyrd to P!nk and My Chemical Romance.

evidence.note: Salt Shack's artist page: Long Island South Shore cover band based in Amityville, set runs from Elvis to P!nk and Lynyrd Skynyrd to My Chemical Romance; links the band's website and Facebook; next show Sun Oct 11, 2 PM.
NY State business record shows an active Kung Fu Betty LLC in Amityville (filed July 2024), matching the band's home town.
Babylon-area events site lists a Kung Fu Betty show in Amityville's 2026 waterfront concert series.
